title: Perceive-Act Loop
learning_objectives: Model an environment with percepts, actions and a performance measure
Run and log an agent–environment loop
entry_point: reflex_vacuum_agent(percept); class VacuumWorld(dirt, location); run(agent, env, steps)
hints: Score after each step: `sum(not d for d in env.dirt.values()) - (1 if action in ('Left', 'Right') else 0)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Score after each action: clean squares minus 1 for movement.
Log the percept seen *before* the action.
Copy the dirt dict inside VacuumWorld.
A simple reflex agent keeps moving even when everything is clean.
